card.name: Linking words in discovery stories
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (comma, from, by, to, when, of) right after text about how something was discovered, where the next words say how it was found, such as by looking or by chance.

modes.label: How a discovery happened
modes.description: A linking word follows 'discovery' or 'discovered' and leads into the means or circumstance of finding.

modes.label: Origin from observation
modes.description: A word like from or by comes before looking at or observing something that led to a new finding.
modes.example: Discoveries often come<< from>> just looking at it," she explained.

card.writes: It suppresses the word discover and its forms, and promotes words like curiosity and skepticism, so the next word is not another 'discover'.
card.plain: It marks the little word in a sentence about how something came to be found, just before the way it was found is given.
